judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the bug is unfixed and its newly added acceptance test will fail. It also omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update mentioned in both the issue acceptance criteria and its own Definition of Done. While the candidate did update `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, it placed the new guarantee inside the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (after changing the heading text to say 'two remaining properties' while keeping three bullets) rather than moving it to the main spec body like the reference did. Finally, it created a separate `beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts` file and left `.lore/dod.md` in the tree instead of adding the test to the existing `chatOrchestrator.test.ts` suite.
